name: portavoce
description: Sends a push and an email when a Claude Code usage limit resets. Token-free: no model calls.

ntfy_topic.title: ntfy topic
ntfy_topic.description: Optional. Leave empty to push to a private topic Portavoce makes (claude-portavoce-<random>); run /portavoce topic to see it and subscribe the phone app. Set a name here to use your own.

notify_email.title: Notification email
notify_email.description: Where ntfy sends the limit-restored email.

ntfy_token.title: ntfy access token
ntfy_token.description: Your ntfy.sh access token; ntfy.sh refuses emails from anonymous requests.
